name: Water Heater Repair
description: Expert water heater repair and replacement services for tank and tankless systems
problems: No hot water or inconsistent temperature
solutions: Anode rod replacement to prevent corrosion

faqs.question: How long does a water heater typically last?
faqs.answer: Traditional tank water heaters last 8-12 years, while tankless models can last 15-20 years with proper maintenance.

faqs.question: Should I repair or replace my water heater?
faqs.answer: If your unit is over 10 years old, requires frequent repairs, or has significant rust or leaks, replacement is usually more cost-effective.

faqs.question: What size water heater do I need?
faqs.answer: Size depends on household size and usage. A family of 4 typically needs a 50-gallon tank or an 8-10 GPM tankless unit.
